correctness.rationale: For canonical unweighted pentablock Hardy norm obtained by pushforward normalized T³ Haar measure under Ψ=(ξ(λ1-λ2)/2,λ1+λ2,λ1λ2), two independent phase symmetries orthogonalize pure a^k powers from all monomials involving s or p. Those latter monomials vanish at A(a)=(a,0,0), so the restricted evaluation kernel lies in the closed pure-power subspace (using bounded evaluations from the foundational source). Vandermonde gives ||a^k||²=4^(-k)binom(2k,k), hence K(t)=Σ4^k/binom(2k,k)t^k = _2F1(1,1;1/2;t). A beta-integral yields K(t)=(1-t)^(-1)+sqrt(t)arcsin(sqrt(t))/(1-t)^(3/2), holomorphic at t=0. Expansion in u=sqrt(1-t) gives K=(π/2)u^-3 -(π/4)u^-1 + 1/3 +O(u); sharp evaluation norm grows as sqrt(π/2)(1-r²)^(-3/4). The reproducing inequality is tight at kernel vectors. Independently checked exact coefficients k≤30, coefficient recurrence, and sample numerical evaluation.
